nicknames: Where The Turf Meets The Surf

main_dirt.bias_notes: Summer dirt surface typically rides fast and glib, heavily favoring early speed ('E') and horses that can secure the inside rail. Deep closers ('C') are at a severe disadvantage in sprints (5.5F to 6.5F) unless there is a confirmed, suicidal pace duel.
main_dirt.post_bias: Fair in routes, but inside posts (1-4) hold a distinct advantage in dirt sprints by allowing runners to save ground and avoid kickback.

main_turf.stretch_length: Late stretch run is relatively short
main_turf.bias_notes: Features a tight first turn, especially when the temporary rail is moved out (18-30 feet). This track geometry places a massive premium on tactical speed and ground-saving trips.
main_turf.post_bias: HARD PENALTY: In 1 Mile and 1 1/16 Mile turf routes, posts 8 and higher receive an automatic -5 point penalty due to severe ground loss into the immediate first turn (unless sole 'E' speed).

handicapping_angles.durante_geometry_hard_penalty: Apply an automatic -5 point penalty to horses drawn in Post 8 or wider in 1-Mile or 1 1/16-Mile Del Mar turf routes, unless they are the sole 'E' (Early Speed) runner in the field.
handicapping_angles.ship_and_win_veto_and_acclimation_penalt: Del Mar's 'Ship & Win' is an owner purse incentive, NOT a handicapping edge. Never boost out-of-state shippers for this program. Apply a -2 point acclimation penalty to out-of-state shippers making their first start on Del Mar turf.
handicapping_angles.maiden_class_drop_bug_fix: Disable class drop bonus (+10 pts) for MSW to MCL drops. MSW-to-MCL drops signal vulnerable form. Only non-maiden class drops receive bonus points.
handicapping_angles.synthetic_to_dirt_discount: Be highly skeptical of horses shipping in from Golden Gate Fields or Woodbine with high synthetic speed figures. Discount their ratings by -3 points when running on Del Mar's main dirt oval.
handicapping_angles.turf_sprint_cavalry_charge: In 5-furlong turf sprints, heavily upgrade horses with proven 21.x opening quarter speed drawn in posts 1-5. Downgrade deep closers regardless of their class.
handicapping_angles.horse_for_course_bias: Del Mar is a very idiosyncratic track. Always grant a +3 point bonus to horses with a proven track record (multiple in-the-money finishes) specifically at Del Mar over the past two summers.
